document.title: Read Markdown diffs as rendered Markdown, with the changed words marked
document.summary: A Markdown file in a review renders as Markdown and still shows what changed.
document.why: [PR #197](source:s1) says a skill's Markdown is hard to read in a line diff: a paragraph is one long line, so a two-word edit shows as a whole red and a whole green line.

sources.label: PR #197
sources.title: Read Markdown diffs as rendered Markdown, with the changed words marked

groups.title: Rows from git's lines
groups.summary: `markdownRows` in `markdown-diff.ts` splits both sides of a file into blocks and uses git's hunk lines to pair them into context rows and change rows.

attention.note: `wordMarks` marks no words in a block when more than 60% of its words changed (`REWRITE_SHARE`), and stops after 150 ms (`WORD_DIFF_MS`). Such a block shows only its red or green tint. Two unrelated texts of 9,000 words each took 11 s to compare without the limit. Decide if these two numbers fit your skill diffs.

notes.body: A changed link target or image path has the same rendered words on both sides, so the row shows source lines.
`.mdc` is the Cursor rule format: Markdown with front matter.

fileNotes.package.json: Adds the Markdown parser, its GFM extension, and `diff` as dev dependencies.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/markdown-diff.ts: New: blocks, rows, word marks, and the pins that hang on a block.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/markdown-diff.test.ts: 21 cases, such as a removed block that must stay before the block after it.

groups.title: The rendered rows
groups.summary: `MarkdownDiff` draws the rows in one column or two, with the tints, notes, comments, and moved marks of the source diff.

attention.note: The rendered view does not run HTML, fetch images, or follow relative links. `rawHtml` shows a tag such as `<kbd>` as its source, `img` shows the alt text, and a relative link is a styled `span`. Only `http`, `https`, and `mailto` links open. Decide if a reviewer needs to see images of the repository here.

fileNotes.src/ui/components/MarkdownDiff.tsx: New: `useMarkdownRows` reads both sides with `fetchFile`; `MarkdownDiff` draws the rows of one patch.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/MarkdownDiff.module.cs: New: the look of rendered tags under `.prose`, and the `mark` color.
fileNotes.src/ui/PierreDiff.tsx: Exports `SplitResizeHandle`, so the split view keeps one ratio.

groups.title: Rendered or Source
groups.summary: `HunkView` shows `MarkdownDiff` in place of `PierreFileDiff` for a Markdown file, and one shared choice in `markdown-view.ts` switches every file.

notes.body: `null` rows mean a side could not be read; the file then shows its source diff.

fileNotes.src/ui/components/HunkView.tsx: Adds the control to a Markdown file's header; the hunk count no longer wraps.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/markdown-view.ts: New: the choice, kept in `localStorage`; `rendered` when nothing is stored.

commits.subject: Markdown files read as rendered prose in the diff
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A Markdown file's hunks render as Markdown: git's lines decide which blocks are removed and added, and the words that differ are marked inside them. Notes, comments, focus ranges, moved blocks, and the split layout work as they do in the source diff. A Rendered/Source control on each Markdown file, and the m key, switch every Markdown file; the choice is remembered.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
